description: Gina Mitten is the only pro-choice Democrat running for State Senate in Missouri SD 4. She is endorsed by Access MO and labor unions including UAW, CWA, AFT, and Unite HERE! Her primary opponent Steve Butz voted with Republicans to outlaw abortion in Missouri.
